gloss: no artificial coloring; free of added dyes

definitions.gloss: no artificial coloring; free from added dyes
definitions.explanation: A food label claim indicating that no artificial colorants or dyes have been added to a product. Commonly seen on Japanese food packaging alongside other natural/additive-free claims.

examples.japanese: {無着色|むちゃくしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I try to choose foods with no artificial coloring.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦たらこ→たらこ：15258_tarako⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無着色|むちゃくしょく}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧な⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This cod roe has no artificial coloring, so it has a natural color.

examples.japanese: {無着色|むちゃくしょく}・⟦{無添加|むてんか}→無添加：19283_mutenka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦{志向|しこう}→志向：12607_shikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{消費者|しょうひしゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Products with no artificial coloring or additives are popular among health-conscious consumers.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (no; without) + ⟦{着色|ちゃくしょく}→着色：13708_chakushoku⟧ (coloring; dyeing). Frequently appears on food packaging as a label claim, especially on products like mentaiko, pickles, and processed meats where artificial coloring is sometimes added.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無着色|むちゃくしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧: food with no artificial coloring
- {無着色|むちゃくしょく}・⟦{無添加|むてんか}→無添加：19283_mutenka⟧: no artificial coloring or additives
- {無着色|むちゃくしょく}⟦たらこ→たらこ：15258_tarako⟧ / {無着色|むちゃくしょく}⟦{明太子|めんたいこ}→明太子：12729_mentaiko⟧: natural-color cod roe

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無添加|むてんか}→無添加：19283_mutenka⟧: no additives — broader claim covering all artificial additives, not just colorants
- {天然着色料|てんねんちゃくしょくりょう}: natural colorants — dyes derived from natural sources, not artificial
